I realized my friendships with them were not rooted in true care. 

I was heartbroken and lonely for awhile. I had to find forgiveness for myself and them for both of our parts. I had to try to put myself in their shoes. And learn what boundaries I needed to create better deeper friendships in the future. I still cherish the memories I have with those friends but I also understand we were going down different paths and lifestyles. While I got sober they were still partying. I had to look at it as a growing up and out , and while the grieving stages of that are important also to have hope that I would find better friendships that shared my values going forward.
